WITH
  sales_30days AS (
    SELECT ss.*, sr.*
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns AS sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk AND ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk IS NULL AND ss_sold_date_sk <= date_trunc('year', d2.d_date_sk) + INTERVAL '8 month' - INTERVAL '1 day' AND ss_sold_date_sk < date_trunc('year', d2.d_date_sk) + INTERVAL '9 month'
  )
SELECT
  s_store_name,
  s_company_id,
  s_street_number,
  s_street_name,
  s_street_type,
  s_suite_number,
  s_city,
  s_county,
  s_state,
  s_zip,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL AND (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL AND (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 30) AND (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL AND (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 60) AND (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL AND (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 90) AND (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL AND (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM sales_30days
JOIN store ON sales_30days.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
JOIN date_dim AS d1 ON sales_30days.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim AS d2 ON sales_30days.ss_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
WHERE d2.d_year = 2001 AND d2.d_moy = 8
GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip
ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip
LIMIT 100

```sql
  sales_30days AS (
    SELECT ss.*, sr.*
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns AS sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk AND ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk IS NULL AND ss_sold_date_sk <= date_trunc('year', d2.d_date_sk) + INTERVAL '8 month' - INTERVAL '1 day' AND ss_sold_date_sk < date_trunc('year', d2.d_date_sk) + INTERVAL '9 month'
  )
SELECT
  s_store_name,
  s_company_id,
  s_street_number,
  s_street_name,
  s_street_type,
  s_suite_number,
  s_city,
  s_county,
  s_state,
  s_zip,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL AND (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL AND (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 30) AND (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL AND (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 60) AND (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL AND (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 90) AND (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL AND (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM sales_30days
JOIN store ON sales_30days.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
JOIN date_dim AS d1 ON sales_30days.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim AS d2 ON sales_30days.ss_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
WHERE d2.d_year = 2001 AND d2.d_moy = 8
GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip
ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip
LIMIT 100
```

This rewrite eliminates the need for multiple subqueries and reduces the number of joins, which should improve query performance.
